label: The volume of a cylindrical shell
section: The volume of a cylindrical shell
subgoals: Factor the shell volume to 2pi times mean radius times height times thickness
Read the mean radius as the strip midpoint x*
Write V = 2pi times the integral of x times [f(x)-g(x)]

label: Example 2
subgoals: Multiply by radius x to raise the degree to four

label: How to choose the method
subgoals: Use discs or washers when the region matches the axis variable
Use shells when the region matches the perpendicular variable
Prefer the method that avoids inverting the boundary curves
